name: Senior Path
description: Practical AI assistance for everyday tasks (ages 60+)

lessons.title: Welcome to Practical AI
lessons.content: AI can be a helpful assistant for everyday tasks - like having a knowledgeable friend who's always available to help. The key is learning to ask clearly for what you need. This course will show you how to get useful results.
keyPoints: AI can help with emails, letters, and organizing information
Clear instructions lead to better results
You can always try again and improve your request

lessons.title: Exercise 1: Email to Family
lessons.scenario: You want to write an email to your family about an upcoming gathering at your home.
lessons.task: Ask AI to help write the email. Include all the important details: date, time, what you're planning, and what guests should bring.
lessons.evaluationCriteria: clear date and time, location details, event description, what to bring, warm tone
hints: What day and time is it?
What occasion is it? (birthday, holiday, just because)

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Being Specific Helps
lessons.content: The more details you provide, the more helpful AI can be. Instead of saying 'write a letter,' say 'write a formal letter to my insurance company about a billing question, including my policy number.'

examples.vague: Help me with a doctor appointment
examples.specific: Write a list of questions to ask my doctor about my blood pressure medication, including questions about side effects and interactions with other medications

lessons.title: Exercise 2: Organized Shopping List
lessons.scenario: You're planning meals for the week and need a detailed shopping list organized by store sections.
lessons.task: Ask AI to create a shopping list based on your meal plan. Be specific about quantities, preferences (low sodium, whole grain, etc.), and how you want it organized.
lessons.evaluationCriteria: specific items and quantities, dietary preferences, organized by category, clear format
hints: How should it be organized? (by aisle? by meal?)

lessons.title: Exercise 3: Letter to Business
lessons.scenario: You received an incorrect charge on your credit card bill and need to write a letter to dispute it.
lessons.task: Request AI to write a formal letter explaining the situation clearly, including all necessary details like dates, amounts, and your account information.
lessons.evaluationCriteria: professional tone, clear problem description, specific dates and amounts, account details, requested action
hints: What is the incorrect charge for?
What amount was charged? What should it be?
What action do you want them to take?

lessons.title: Exercise 4: Medical Questions List
lessons.scenario: You have an upcoming doctor's appointment and want to make sure you remember to ask about everything important.
lessons.task: Ask AI to help create an organized list of questions for your doctor about your health concerns, current medications, and any symptoms.
lessons.evaluationCriteria: organized by topic, specific symptoms with details, medication questions, clear priority
hints: Any new symptoms? When did they start?

lessons.title: Exercise 5: Travel Itinerary
lessons.scenario: You're planning a trip to visit your grandchildren in another state. You want to organize all the details in one place.
lessons.task: Ask AI to create a detailed travel itinerary including flights, accommodations, activities, and important phone numbers.
lessons.evaluationCriteria: complete travel details, organized by day, contact information, backup plans, readable format
hints: Where are you staying? Address and phone?
What activities are planned each day?
What information do you need easy access to?
Any medical needs or restrictions to note?

lessons.title: Final Exercise: Recipe Organization
lessons.scenario: You have favorite family recipes you want to organize and share with your children and grandchildren. You want them formatted clearly with helpful notes.
lessons.task: Ask AI to help format your recipes professionally, including ingredient lists, step-by-step instructions, serving sizes, and your personal tips.
lessons.evaluationCriteria: clear ingredient list with measurements, step-by-step instructions, serving size, cooking time, personal notes section, easy-to-read format
hints: Which recipes do you want to include?
Any family stories or special tips?
How should it be formatted for easy reading?
